## Deliverable: `/workspace/project` (8 files, 58 KB)

**`driver.py`** — JSON entry point

**`syntax.py`** — byte-filtered tokenizer (rejects vertical tab / all non-listed whitespace) + context-sensitive recursive-descent parser, so services legitimately named `match`, `and`, `allow`… work in paths. Enforces depth ≤16, path ≤16, ≤8 complex rules × ≤32 atoms, ≤4 distinct non-`match` atoms (path ≤4), 32 768 atoms / 65 536 path services, plus derived token/length envelopes so hostile strings fail fast.

**`compiler/compiler.py`** — serial reduction: per-atom complete DFAs (KMP for `endswith`/`contains`), hash-consed negation-normal-form residual expressions, memoised Brzozowski derivatives explored breadth-first, dead-residual contraction, partition-refinement minimisation with a *sound* early oversize abort, then canonical BFS renumbering in increasing label order with `DENY=4294967295`; empty language → one false flag/all-DENY row, all-allow → one true flag/zero row, >8192 rows rejected.

**`ebpf/helper.py`** — `MemoryMap` CPU backend + `Agent` with all 16 ops: atomic stage/commit/retire, spawn/clone/exit with per-pair generation high-water marks, begin/finish with monotone request marks, open/send/recv/close with stream marks, retained packets, receipts, exact 24-byte wire tags, store/load/unlink inode generations, and exact reference/cell/capacity accounting; every rejection is a provable no-op.

**Validation performed:** public check, exact sanity fixture, 8 hand-written suites (lifecycle, transport, files, validation, bounds, policy syntax, u32 exhaustion, atomicity), plus differential fuzzing against two independent references — a naive recomputing runtime model (~500 rounds) and a brute-force Myhill-Nerode oracle / FAdo-based canonicaliser (~2000 policies, 0 mismatches).
